column1: # testees/pcrec/list_limits.tsv -- pcrec's NUMERIC-LIMITS TABLE at the pin
# docs/spec/table_contract.md), archived VERBATIM under a source header --
# the THIRD archive target beside list_axes.tsv / list_definitions.tsv
# (inbox I-25: "ARCHIVE IT beside --list-axes at your re-pin"). Everything
# below this header is the unmodified output of:
# 2026-09-06 by the manager ([B39], the eleventh session). 56 data rows / 7
# columns (name, value, unit, kind, override, anchor, desc) -- one row per
# numeric limit in pcrec src/core/limits.def, in the table's own order. The
# diff from the 334fd10e copy (55 rows, [B37]) is ONE NEW ROW and FOUR
# RE-WORDED ONES, exactly as the b39prep lane predicted from the source diff
#     override `-D`, anchor 3.3), inserted after PCREC_MAX_SUBSET_ELEMS: the
#     AUTO route's own DFA-attempt WORK BUDGET in K7's already-counted
#     subset-element unit -- over budget, AUTO falls back to the VM instead
#     of spending the whole K7 budget on a DFA it may then refuse. A new
#     engine-route input this bench's stamps may show as a VM selection
#     where 334fd10e built a DFA: read RX_ENGINE_SEL / `_WHY` on any such
#   - THREE rows' `override` moved none -> flag, VALUE UNCHANGED, desc
#     extended with the new raise-only per-compile flag: PCREC_MAX_NFA_STATES
#     (`--max-subset-elems`). The bench passes none of them: every pinned
#     config keeps pcrec's defaults, and the 65535 rung's "NFA exceeds
#     131072 states" refusal is UNCHANGED at this pin.
#   - PCREC_MAX_DFA_STATES_TABLE 32000: VALUE and override UNCHANGED, desc
#     re-worded "NOT RAISABLE (N1 survey) -- the emitted table's cell type
# The rows this bench has already met by name, all UNCHANGED:
# forms overflow by -- I-22/I-23's distinct `_WHY` route),
# [ART-SIZE] caps every artifact stamps as its effective limits -- and the
# code cap is the wall altwide's `w-512` VM form still meets at this pin,
# where `w-384` now fits under it as an island), PCREC_NFA_MAX_STATES
# 131072 (the "NFA exceeds 131072 states" refusal the 65535 rung meets --
# O-9/I-20, UNCHANGED at this pin: [OPT-EDGE] STEP 1.1 acts after
# WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR: nothing a RECORD carries is read from it (every
# cap and capacity a record needs is STAMPED per artifact); it is the
# table this bench's overflow readings resolve against BY NAME, archived
# so the pin's limit surface is diffable across re-pins, and `make
# check-harness` diffs it against the pin's live output
# ONE thing DOES read it, and only in order to REFUSE ([B31], 2026-09-02):
# the emitted-size cap axis' raise-only check takes PCREC_MAX_EMIT_BYTES
# and PCREC_MAX_VM_EMIT_CODE_BYTES from here, so a config declaring a
# max_emit_bytes below pcrec's own default is an AdapterError naming both
# numbers before anything is measured. Reading them rather than typing
# them is what keeps this repo from holding a second copy of a pcrec
# constant that could fall out of step; the diff above is what stops that
# SIXTH TSV surface; D90/[LIM-1]). One row per numeric limit in
# src/core/limits.def, in the table's own order.
# unit: the quantity's dimension, or empty for a dimensionless
# kind: "compile budget" (bounds the COMPILER's own analysis or
#   emission; crossing it can refuse a pattern) | "runtime
#   capacity" (bounds the EMITTED MATCHER's own resource use;
#   crossing it is a give-up, never a wrong answer) | "size cap"
#   threshold or default that steers a selection mechanism, not a
#   hard ceiling) | "identifier cap" (bounds a name's length or a
# override: "flag" (a CLI flag or pcrec_options field moves it per
#   compile) | "-D" (only a build-time -D at pcrec's OWN compile
# anchor: the docs/spec/limits.md section this number is
#   documented in, empty when it is not (limits.md states caller-
#   facing PROMISES, not an internals catalogue — see this file's
#   own header and src/core/limits.def's for the boundary).

column7: desc
generated-symbol prefix (-p): a C identifier bound
K38: fixed buffer size for every emitted identifier/sub-expression built from the -p prefix
[SEL-1]: fixed size of the DFA-cap-overflow reason string (RX_ENGINE_WHY source)
M2.8: NFA state-count ceiling; a memory backstop, the DFA caps below usually bind first; --max-nfa-states ALSO raises it per compile (raise-only)

computed-goto DFA attempt engine's state ceiling; --max-dfa-states-goto ALSO raises it per compile (raise-only) -- raising it trades gcc's own superlinear computed-goto compile time (R1 A-3), the caller's cost to accept

table-engine DFA state ceiling; NOT RAISABLE (N1 survey) -- the emitted table's cell type is a C `short`/`unsigned short` (PREMUL_DEAD=65535, indexed dead=-1; src/gen/emit_dfa.c), so a state number the artifact cannot represent would silently truncate; 32000 already sits just under that ceiling
states*classes bound on the DFA transition table (~12 MB source)
[M4.7b]/K7: total NFA-state-list elements the priority subset construction may intern, summed over both machines; --max-subset-elems ALSO raises it per compile (raise-only)

[LIM-2] N1: the AUTO route's own DFA-attempt work budget, in K7's already-counted subset-element unit (Ctx.subset_elems); over budget under --engine=auto abandons the attempt and falls back to VM through the SAME auto-fallback umbrella a PCREC_MAX_SUBSET_ELEMS refusal uses (SEL-1); --engine=dfa is unaffected and pays the full cap above; --max-auto-dfa-elems ALSO raises it per compile (raise-only); -D moves the built-in default (the N1 positive-control test's reference compiler is the one non-default consumer, matching PCREC_MAX_VM_EMIT_CODE_BYTES's own precedent)
[M4.5b]: the VM emitter's own node-count size backstop
[M4.5c]: how many times a bounded repeat may replicate a body with a choice point
[K22]: total replication product along a chain of nested bounded repeats — a literal alias of PCREC_MAX_VM_NODES, not tuned separately
[ENG-BREP]: the counter rung's default unroll factor K, overridden by --unroll=N
[ENG-BREP]: byte-consuming positions a quantifier body may have before possessify.c declines it
[ENG-BREP]: capturing groups a quantifier body may contain before revdet.c declines the reverse-deterministic rung
[OPT-ALTCLS] stage 2: how deep prefix factoring may recurse into a group that just split
FIX-1/K5: the largest {n,m} quantifier count PCRE2 accepts (measured against libpcre2 10.46)
PCRE2's own nested-group depth ceiling (measured); also bounds parser/AST recursion depth
[M6.3]: a named group's name, measured against libpcre2 10.46 (PCRE2 error 148 above it)
a (*VERB) name; PCRE2-internals tier, measured over both name tables
(*LIMIT_MATCH=N) and friends: the accumulator magnitude PCRE2 refuses at (UINT32_MAX/10 - 1)
\p{...}/\P{...} property name, in SIGNIFICANT characters (measured against libpcre2 10.46)
[DD-14 wave G]: per-call-site AST-node splice budget before a call linkage is forced
[DD-14 wave G]: total added AST nodes across every spliced call site in one compile
[ENG-ABS]: the optional anchored match-here machine's own DFA state ceiling, lower than the mandatory pair's

[ART-SIZE]/D84: emitted C bytes OUTSIDE table initializers; --max-emit-code-bytes ALSO raises it per-compile (raise-only); -D moves the built-in default (run_size_term.sh's reference-compiler consumer)
[OPT-4]: the advisory --warn-emit-bytes default (never refuses, 0 disables) ALSO settable per-compile; -D moves the built-in default
[ART-SIZE]/D84: the whole comment-excluded artifact; --max-emit-bytes ALSO raises it per-compile (raise-only); -D moves the built-in default
[ART-SIZE]: the emitted-size knee above which the unroll-K size term evaluates the ladder at all
D51: default backtrack-resumption budget; --step-budget=N overrides per compile
D49: default forward-only-work budget, a separate counter from steps; --work-budget=N overrides
D73: default resume-stack capacity for the UNBOUNDED-depth class; --backtrack-frames=N overrides
D73: default trail capacity paired with VM_DEFAULT_RESUME_FRAMES
[M4.6a]: clamp ceiling for the BOUNDED-depth class's exact auto-sizing under --backtrack-frames
[M4.6a]: trail's own clamp ceiling, paired with VM_MAX_AUTO_RESUME_FRAMES
[ENG-ISL]: fewest literal alternatives an alternation island is built for at all; below it vm_alt's chain emits the alternation
[ENG-ISL]: fewest literal alternatives an island that PUSHES is built for -- one whose alternatives are not prefix-free, so its candidate chain has a second entry and the artifact stays framed
[ENG-ISL]: most literal words an alternation's subtree may enumerate to before the island declines (the bench's widest altwide rung is 4096)
[ENG-ISL]: total literal bytes across every enumerated word; bounds the cross product of concatenated alternations, which is exponential in principle
[ENG-ISL]: alternation NESTING the enumeration may recurse through; a pattern controls this depth, so it is a bound on pcrec's own C stack (D10/R-2)
[ENG-ISL]: measured marginal emitted-code bytes per alternation-island trie node, for the island-vs-chain size comparison
[ENG-ISL]: measured marginal emitted-code bytes per AST node of the subtree vm_alt's serial chain would emit instead

[ENG-ISL]: how many times the chain's estimated emitted size the island may reach before it declines; on the ESTIMATOR the two populations separate at 2.60 against 4.02, and 2 is validated by the random size census (0 refused, max artifact growth 1.03x) rather than argued

[CC-DIFF] STEP 2: emitted VM program bytes at or below which the entry chain is inlined into the three _in entries (rung FORWARD); above it one shared out-of-line body (rung SHARED). --vm-entry-shape=N overrides the decision outright
src/opt/prefix_k.c: how many literal-prefix candidates the offset-skip analysis may carry
src/opt/prefix_k.c: how many offsets the selected offset-set prefilter candidate may carry
src/opt/callgraph.c: the minimum-width analysis' saturation ceiling (== PCREC_W_UNBOUNDED)

[OPT-5]: how many scan edges one DFA machine may carry — src/opt/scanedge.c takes the longest chains first, src/gen/emit_dfa.c sizes its array by it; since [OPT-EDGE] STEP 1 an edge costs NO compare on the emitted loop's generic path (the shared sentinel), so this is an emitted-bytes budget awaiting a measured re-choice

[OPT-5] precondition (5): the SHORTEST bounded counted-class run src/opt/scanedge.c will collapse into a scan edge (the unbounded self-loop is admitted at any length). MEASURED 2026-09-04 against the STEP 1.1 loop -- studies/scan_edge_ladder/run_floor.sh, 3 runs x 15 rounds, edge vs -fno-scan-edge on the same pattern: at m=2, 3 and 4 the two arms are NOT separated by more than the per-round range on either family, so D77 no-gap-no-move keeps this at 2; the only resolvable separation is m=8 nullable, edge/noedge 0.9855 median [IQR 0.0243]. The edge SIZE win is unconditional and is the standing reason to admit m=2
src/parse/mod_recursion.c: saturation ceiling for a (?N)/(?+N)/(?-N) recursion-call number
src/parse/mod_backrefs.c: saturation ceiling for a \N/\g{N} backreference number
src/parse/mod_lookaround.c: fixed buffer size for the §2.5/§2.7 lookaround diagnostic text
